question: Who among the following sportspersons was awarded the Chhattisgarh Veerni Award 2021 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dutee Chand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dutee Chand** was awarded the **Chhattisgarh Veerni Award in 2021**.
 
• Dutee Chand is an Indian **professional sprinter **and a **national champion in women's 100 metres** event.
 
• The award recognizes the **contribution of Indian women** in different fields, including sports.
 
• This award is an initiative by the Chhattisgarh state government to honour the** outstanding work of women in various sectors**.
 
• The award aims to **uplift and motivate women** in India to reach greater heights and make significant contributions to society and their respective fields.
 
• Dutee Chand receiving this award emphasizes her contribution to Indian sports, notably through her sprinting records and her efforts to promote athletics in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shikhar Dhawan:**

 
 
• Shikhar Dhawan is a** renowned cricketer** in the Indian national team, known for his role as an **opening batsman.**
 
• His cricketing talent came to light when he scored the fastest century on Test debut against **Australia in 2013.**
 
• He played a significant role in India bagging the **Champions Trophy in 2013.**
 
 
 
• **Bajrang Punia:**
 
 
• Bajrang Punia is an **Indian freestyle wrestler.**
 
• He has represented India at the** Olympics and other international competition**s, earning numerous accolades.
 
• Punia became the first Indian wrestler to win two **World Championships medals.**
 
 
 
• **P V Sindhu:**
 
 
• P V Sindhu, or **Pusarla Venkata Sindhu**, is an Indian professional badminton player.
 
• She received global recognition when she became the first Indian to win the** BWF World Championships in 2019.**
 
• Sindhu has been a **silver medalist in the Olympics** and is one of the leading badminton players in the nation.
